summary: The DSH dependency surface moved from the stale 0.1.1-rc.2 pin to the current published prerelease line (Issue #77). devDependencies for every @deepseek-ai/dsh-* package that has 0.1.2-rc.1 now pin 0.1.2-rc.1 (dsh-client-runtime stays 0.1.1-rc.2, its published maximum; cordis ^4.0.2, schemastery ^3.18.2), peer ranges explicitly accept both prerelease tuples (^0.1.1-rc.2 || ^0.1.2-rc.1) because node-semver prerelease rules never let ^0.1.1-rc.2 admit 0.1.2-*; pnpm overrides pin the 0.1.2-rc.1 transitive matrix (dsh-storage-domain pinned back to 0.1.1-rc.2 because upstream published the line without it). The removed settingsNamespace() helper was replaced by the literal namespace string per the 0.1.2 API, and two deterministic tests gate every peer range against the compiled devDependency and the supported prerelease line.
steps: Verified: npm registry's latest published surface is 0.1.2-rc.1 (next) for the DSH line; the issue's 0.1.3-alpha.1 exists only in the upstream source checkout (d347e703), not on npm, so it is documented but cannot be compiled against.

Install required explicit pnpm overrides for the 0.1.2-rc.1 transitive peers (wildcard override did not apply in this pnpm version); the full 0.1.2 matrix is not publishable because dsh-storage-domain has no 0.1.2 release, so it stays pinned to 0.1.1-rc.2.
0.1.2-rc.1 removed the settingsNamespace() helper; replaced with the literal 'rlm' constant (SettingsNamespaceInput validates it).

evidence.target: pnpm typecheck + full test suite on 0.1.2-rc.1

evidence.note: every peer range accepts its devDep; supported 0.1.2-rc.1 line accepted

limitations: The upstream source line 0.1.3-alpha.1 is not published, so peers accept it (per issue intent) but CI can only compile against 0.1.2-rc.1; dsh-client-runtime remains an rc.2 peer because npm has no newer version.
